title: Gone (2026 TV series)
executive_producers: George Kay Willow Grylls Matt Sandford
premise_summary: Gone is a British television series written by George Kay that first broadcast on ITV1 and ITVX on 8 March 2026. The cast is led by Eve Myles and David Morrissey.
